ADVISOR RULING (2026-10-15 00:07) on the helper gap: APPROVE the narrower existing-capability option; no session.rs change, no containment lane needed. '/oracle' in my ruling was illustrative; the binding property is that a trial file can never shadow or alter the oracle.
Contract: (1) freeze the bundle from the trusted commit (via git, as ruled) into a content-addressed dir OUTSIDE /tmp and outside any worktree/trial root, e.g. $XDG_CACHE_HOME/aida/regen/oracle/<oracle_bundle_sha256>/ (default ~/.cache); before EVERY run re-verify the bundle hash, and refuse on mismatch. (2) bind it read-only at its identical canonical host path through the existing read_allowlist; the trial root is the helper's rw worktree. Assert the bundle path is not inside the trial root and the trial root is not inside it. (3) resolve oracle_command argv[0] to an ABSOLUTE path inside the bundle (never PATH or trial-relative). (4) cwd: run through 'env --chdir=<bundle>' (coreutils) inside the sandbox if available, else a tiny bundled exec wrapper; no 'sh -c' string interpolation. (5) Locator env vars AIDA_REGEN_TRIAL_ROOT / AIDA_REGEN_PREFIX as ruled. (6) Tests: the substitution reproduction scores the trusted FAIL; a tampered bundle (hash mismatch) refuses; symlink-escape and '..' rejected; the trial cannot write into the bundle (ro).
Implement the amended contract on #2660, mark it ready, and mail the head. It stays stacked on #2658.
subject: RULING: TASK-1730 helper gap — use identical-path ro bind, proceed
